title: Graphic Designer
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Create designs for posters, brochures, advertisements, social media, websites, and presentations.
 Develop and maintain brand identity, including logos, colors, fonts, and visual guidelines.
 Understand client or business requirements and convert them into effective visual concepts.
 Use design software such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign.
 Select appropriate fonts, colors, images, layouts, and graphics.
 Edit and retouch photographs and other visual assets.
 Prepare designs for digital and print production.
 Collaborate with marketing, content, web, and product teams.
 Review feedback and make necessary design revisions.
 Ensure designs are creative, consistent, accurate, and aligned with brand guidelines.

Key Skills: Photoshop,Creative Designing,Illustrator,Canva,Corel Draw,Adobe,Graphic Designing,Indesign
